company.name: Covie
company.shortDescription: Covie develops a platform that connects innovative businesses to insurance data.
company.description:
Covie develops a platform that connects innovative businesses to insurance data. Its platform solution retrieves and validates insurance records in real-time, directly from the issuing carrier. One integration allows users to work with data from any of its constantly growing list of insurers.

The company was founded by a team of software and insurance industry experts on a mission to make insurance data more accessible and easier to work with. They are empowering the next class of innovative builders to craft a better experience around insurance, eliminate inefficiencies, and effectively manage risks.
